data.credibility: Management demonstrates solid execution on core financial guidance like revenue growth and capex, but frequently drops or stops reporting on specific medium-term unit expansion targets and segment contributions over subsequent quarters.

lines.line: Promised 30-plus hotel openings in FY26, but the status is currently slipping.
Expected healthy management fee growth with strong EBITDA flow-through; on track.
Expected new business growth of 30 percent in H2 FY26; dropped.
Promised Taj Ganges 100-key expansion in Q3/Q4 FY26; successfully delivered.
Promised Taj Lucknow 95-key expansion by 2027; dropped.
Guided double-digit revenue growth for FY26; kept and delivered.
Guided FY26 capex between Rs. 1,000 to 1,200 crores; kept at Rs. 1,000 crores.
Expected Tree of Life portfolio to reach 100 hotels; dropped.
Brij acquisition completion promised by March 31, 2026; kept.
Atmantan projected to generate INR 100 crores in FY27; dropped.
Brij projected to contribute INR 100 crores in FY27; dropped.
Strategic acquisitions expected to contribute INR 250-300 crores in FY27; dropped.
Expected 60 plus hotel openings in FY27; slipping.
Ginger and new business verticals expected to deliver 25% plus growth; kept and delivered.
Expected FY27 revenue growth between 12% and 14%; on track.
Ginger portfolio expected to reach 250 hotels by end of FY27; dropped.
Committed to invest INR 1,000 to 1,200 crores annually in capex; dropped.
Portfolio approaching and crossing 650 hotels milestone; delivered.
Taj Bandstand expected to start with INR 1,000 crores revenue by 2030-2031; pending.
Ginger brand expected to reach 150 operational hotels by March 31, FY27; pending.
Oriental Hotels merger expected to drive 6% to 7% upside in FY28; pending.
